Subject: Request: extra sandbox fuel for overnight soak (POC)

Hi Priyom,

Quick ask — we finished the daytime smoke runs and saw good stability, but the team wants to run an overnight soak (20:00–06:00 PT) to validate 99th percentile latency at scale and a sustained 8k–12k RPS throughput window. Our current trial allocation will exhaust around 02:00am.

Can Redwood extend a short promotional buffer (48–72h) or add a temporary voucher to cover the night so we can finish telemetry capture (p95/p99, tail latency, and KV-cache hit metrics)? This is critical for our internal sign-off next week.

Attached: acme-night-soak-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet) — workload profile and sequence lengths.

Thanks — will be brief on follow-ups.

—Sarah
Sarah Hayes
Staff SRE, ACME Corp

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Sarah — thanks for the clear plan and the attachment. We're happy to help get the soak completed. Two quick clarifying points before I escalate to promo approvals:

- Can you confirm target peak RPS (you mentioned 8k–12k) and expected token burn per minute at peak?
- Any IP/data controls needed for the run (VPC pulls, logs retention beyond 30d)?

If no special compliance needs, I'll ask Marissa for a short-term promotional voucher (72h) and copy Karthik for any Dedicated capacity tips if you want to reduce cost by using a quantized variant during the soak.

I'll follow up with the voucher code and the telemetry hook instructions once approved.

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Voucher covers hosted trial credits only (no Dedicated/Reserved billing).
- Max spend cap: $5,000 (covers token burn estimate in the attached plan).
- We require the customer to sign the short acknowledgement (one-paragraph) that the uplift is for validation only and that usage above cap will be billed to their account.

If all clear I will generate the voucher and pass to Priyom to distribute.

—Marissa

Thanks — quick ops notes for the midnight soak:

- Recommend using the quantized model variant we discussed (q4_KV) to shave ~30% token cost while keeping p95 behavior comparable. We'll feed requests through the US-WEST region to avoid cross-region noise.
- Set up a continuous KV-cache prefix for steady-state traffic; this will reduce cold-start tail behavior.
- Add an automated fallback policy: if 95th percentile latency crosses 850ms for 5m, switch to the smaller replica and notify the SRE pager.

Grace, telemetry endpoint details needed from your side so we can add the ingestion hook before the run. Priyom, if you get the voucher I can post the config snippet to the shared Box link.

—Karthik
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
